summary: Retest after refactor moving the prediction dashboard to /predictor with a home-page teaser. Backend suite (11 tests, incl. new email-safety-guard unit tests) passes clean. Rewrote 5 obsolete home-page-based browser checks to target /predictor and added 3 new checks for the teaser/impact-counter/cross-page-nav criteria. Found ONE real frontend bug: clicking predictor-teaser-open-button on '/' navigates to /predictor but lands at scrollY 876 instead of 0 (SPA route change does not reset scroll position), reproduced twice (not flaky). All other criteria pass.

bugs.criterion: Home page navigation and animated impact counters work
bugs.description: Clicking predictor-teaser-open-button on '/' (after the page is scrolled down to the teaser section) navigates to /predictor but the new route renders already scrolled to window.scrollY=876 instead of 0, so the user lands mid-dashboard instead of at the top of the predictor page.
bugs.evidence: Browser check 'home-teaser-and-impact-counters' failed twice (not flaky) with 'Expected scrollY 0 on /predictor navigation, got 876'. Screenshot /root/.emergent/automation_output/20261006_164622_361/home-teaser-and-impact-counters-failure.png shows the predictor form/footer in view, not the top of the page, confirming the SPA router does not scroll-to-top on navigation. Backend is unaffected (pure frontend routing issue).

action_items.detail: Add a scroll-to-top-on-route-change effect (e.g. in a router layout/ScrollManager) so client-side navigations like the predictor-teaser-open-button land at scrollY 0 on the destination route.

checks.evidence: New test file imports backend.lib.email._assert_safe_email directly and asserts ValueError for <form> content, http:// link, credential-ask phrase 'reply with your password', and mismatched anchor text 'bank.com' pointing to a different host, plus a passing case for safe https html. 5 passed in 1.06s standalone, 11 passed in full suite.

No HTTP>=400, no console errors.

checks.evidence: impact-metric-diverted counter animation completed to a non-zero value (passed) and nav-link-products scroll (passed, #products top within 150px after retry-wait). FAILED on final step: predictor-teaser-open-button navigates to /predictor but with scrollY=876, not 0. See bugs[0].
